comments.body:
7★ shipwreck that requires R7 Archaeology. I pulled this at 1258,3305 northeast of Candia in-between the Turkish mainland and the little island of Rhodes. I got the following:

Medium Storm Sail
Miser's Chains x 49
Silverwork x 56
Gold Scarab
Pearl x 70
Galileo-style Telescope
